The structure of PrMg2Hf crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1mm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—Pr2Mg4Hf2—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Hf and Pr each surrounded by 14 neighbors (6 Hf/Pr and 8 Mg), while Mg adopts a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 neighbors (4 Hf, 4 Mg, 4 Pr). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Hf- and Pr-centered 14-vertex polyhedra.
